generalCriterionList.description: Tenders from Joint ventures will not be acceptable

Special Conditions As per Government Circular No:FD263/Expenditure-12/2022 Date:11/05/2022 if the L-1 Contractor does not Sign the contract with Any Reason or if Does not come Forward to Execute the Contract or if Ineligible for any Reason as per KTPP Act and Rules the EMD Amount of Such Tenderer Shall be Forfeited as per Tender rules
The Tenderer should submit the Employees provident fund (EPF) registration certificate and latest EPF paid receipt through e-Procurement Portal

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by any State Government / Government of India /Union Territory

It will be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of KPPP Portal on or before the last date and time of bid submission

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The department will not be responsible for non-accessibility of KPPP Portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode will be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection
The tender processing fee will not be refundable

The successful Tenderer should deliver to the employer a Security Deposit in the form of FDR/e-Bank guarantee (Any Nationalized bank / Scheduled Bank) as per government circular No:FD5/expenditure-12/2023 Dt:15.05.2023 / Insurance Surety Bonds issued by Insurance Company authorized by Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India as per government circular No:FD944/expenditure-12/2024 Dt:03.04.2025 in favour of the Administrator, CADA, CBP, Mysore for an amount equivalent to 5% of the Contract price and plus additional security for unbalanced tenders in the form of DD/FDR/BG in favour of the Administrator, CADA, CBP, Mysore within 20 days in receipt of Letter of Acceptance in accordance with the conditions of contract at the time of agreement

Eligible Tenderers will be qualified only if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as per formula indicated in section 2, Instructions to tenderers - 3 of K/W-4 and Government order No FD 876 EXP-12/2017 , Bangalore Dated 10/10/2017.Note: For assessing bid capacity the tenderer should submit all qualification information in prescribed format. Section 3 of K/W-4 with due certificate from the bidder as well as competent authority.

Rates quoted shall be exclusive of GST, GST as applicable will be paid separately at prevailing rates during admission of the bill. The provision of present rate of GST (i.e. 18 percentage) is made in KPP Portal towards GST in lump sum

Regarding royalty charges the tenderers should abide by the Circular of Director, Mines and Geology Department, Bangalore. Circular No. gabhuei/dcb/2024-25, Dated: 28-01-2025 as per order/Circulars issued by GOK from Time to Time
Conditional tenders will not be accepted
The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender. The employer will not be responsible and liable for those costs
The Percentage Rate quoted shall include the Royalty Charges on construction materials and other taxes are as per prevailing Government Orders

As per Karnataka State Government order No.LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore Dated 01.01.2007 and Government Letter No.PW/134/BMS/2007 Dated 27.7.2007, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards Construction Labour Welfare fund. The tenderer shall abide by the directions of Government towards recovery as modified by the Government from time to time

All scanned documents to be uploaded Should be in original and the Executive Engineer will verify the original Documents at any stage before recommending for approval. Bidders should produce their original Documents at the time of evaluation of bid for physical verification during office hours related to uploaded documents in KPPP Portal immediately after opening of the bid. Failed to Submit the original Documents for Verification, Such Tender will be Rejected
The tenderers are requested to abide by the instructions and conditions contained in the Standard Tender Documents KW-4 and further orders thereon

In the case of death of the contractor after executing the agreement/commencement of the work, his legal heir, if he/she is an eligible qualified registered contractor and is willing to execute and complete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of the work
All safety precautions, warnings, signs, deployment of security guards has to be ensured so that no untoward incident happens on account of negligence or any project activity

All materials required for the work, shall be procured by the tenderer himself and should be got tested by the quality control authorities at his own cost before use on work. If employer wishes to engage third party inspecting agency for the said work, apart from the quality control authorities, then the contractor should cooperate with the third party test
Typographical errors if any will not be the ground for any claims by the contractor

All items in the tender include all lead and lifts, loading & unloading, transportation, labour, hire charges of machineries, curing for concrete works, cost of conveyance of all materials and all other such incidental charges necessary for successful completion of works as per detailed technical specification and direction of Engineer-in-charge of the work

The tenderer should execute the work as per site condition & as directed by Engineer-in-charge of the work if any changes needed & The tenderer should submit quality control reports and photos in 3 stages (before, during the execution and after completion) along with the bill otherwise bill will not be accepted

Tenderer should take all precautions to ensure that no damage is caused to the existing structures which have been constructed by other agencies during project execution. If any damages is caused it has to be rectified at his own risk and cost
The tenderer should maintain the work during the defect liability period. Defect liability period will be Two Years from the date of completion of the entire work
Before tendering for the works the tenderer shall inspect the work site personally
Corrigendum will be published in the KPPP Portal website only for any Further/modifications and corrections
The tender inviting authority reserves the rights to reject any or all tenders without assigning any reasons
Income tax,GSTand TDS recovery will be applicable as for Recent Govt. Orders
Other Conditions will be as per tender document

technicalCriterionList.description: The Contractor should have satisfactorily completed as prime contractor for at-least one similar nature of work such as Improvements to Ayacut Road/WBM Road Works of value not less than Rs. 203.00 Lakhs (usually not less than 50% of the amount put to Tender) of the last Five Preceding Financial Years (2021-22 to 2025-26) - Work done certificate should be obtained from the officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer. Work done certificate should be in the prescribed form as in K/W-4 (Section 3: 1.3).(The cost of completed work of the previous year shall be updated to 2026-27 by giving weightage of 10% per year to bring it to the price level of financial year in which the tenders are invited).

As per Clause 3.3 (a) of K/W-4- The intending bidder/firm/company should furnish the details of required Machinery/Equipments as mention below. Details like RC,FC Lease Agreement should contain the Vehicle Name with valid R.C. etc., for Current year for the above said work to be uploaded 1.Tippers-04 Nos Own/Lease 2. Vibratory Roller-01 Nos Own/Lease. 3. Excavator/Hitachi-02 Nos Own/Lease, 4. Ajax /Concrete Mixer-01 Nos Own/Lease. 5. Water Tank Mounted with Tractor/Truck-02 Nos Own/Lease

As per Clause 3.2 (c) of K/W-4 - The Contractor should have executed in any one financial year the minimum quantities of work not less (usually 80% of the estimated quantities in any one year, (for a usually 80% of the peak annual rate of construction) in the last five preceding financial years (2021-22 to 2025-26). Quantities should be in the prescribed form as in K/W-4 (Section 3: 1.4) (1) Embankment/Shoulders-20361.00 Cum, (2) Cement Concrete-183.00 Cum, (3) WBM (G-I&GII)-7401.00 Cum, (4) Steel-3.64 Tonne
The tenderer shall scan the original and valid Registration certificate from KPWD/CPWD for this bid and upload the same

To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in his name should have in the last five years i.e.2021-22 to 2025-26. Achieved in at least two financial years a minimum financial turnover (in all classes of civil engineering construction works only) of Rs. 812.00 Lakhs, at 2026-27 Price level. Note: Annual turnover certificate by Chartered Accountant and audited balance sheets for last five years along with Income tax returns shall be uploaded. Financial turnover of previous years will be given a weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the 2026-27 price level (usually not less than two times the Amount put to tender). The tenderer shall scan the original documents for this bid and upload the same(If UDIN Number not mentioned treated as incomplete and rejected)

technicalCriterionList.description: Liquid Assets and or availability of credit facilities of not less than For work under For work Rs 122.00 Lakhs (Credit lines/ letter of credit/ certificates from Nationalized Banks for meeting the fund requirements etc. (Line of credit in the prescribed form) (Section 3:1.10).

The Contractor who meet the above specified minimum qualifying criteria will only be qualified if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value.The available tender capacity will be calculated as under (Assessed available tender capacity A X N X 1.5 -B) (1) A-Maximum value of civil engineering works executed in any one year during the last five financial years (updated to 2026-27 price level) taking into account the completed as well as works in progress. (2) N-Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which Tenders are invited. (180/365 Days) (3) B-Value, at 2026-27 price level, of existing commitments and on-going works to be completed during the next 180 Days period of completion of the works for which Tenders are invited Note: The statements showing the value of existing commitments and on-going works as well as the stipulated period of completion remaining for each of the works listed should be countersigned by the Employer in charge, not below the rank of an Executive Engineer or equivalent& Audited balance sheets mentioning UDIN number should be mandatorily uploaded along with tender, failing with which tender will be liable for rejection
